# Message

Lays out one conversation message with optional avatar, header, footer, and alignment.

## Contents

- [Installation](#installation)
- [Usage](#usage)
- [Alignment](#alignment)
- [Header, footer, and avatar](#header-footer-and-avatar)
- [Grouping consecutive messages](#grouping-consecutive-messages)
- [Actions and semantics](#actions-and-semantics)
- [Content ownership](#content-ownership)

## Installation

Add Message from the configured StackTrace registry.

```shell
npx shadcn-vue@latest add @stacktrace/message
```

## Usage

Message owns the row layout. Place an optional `MessageAvatar` beside `MessageContent`, then render the visible surface with [Bubble](https://ui.stacktrace.sk/docs/components/bubble). Header and footer slots remain aligned with that surface.

**Message example**

```vue
<template>
  <div class="flex w-full max-w-sm flex-col gap-6">
    <Message align="end">
      <MessageAvatar>
        <Avatar><AvatarFallback>YO</AvatarFallback></Avatar>
      </MessageAvatar>
      <MessageContent>
        <Bubble>
          <BubbleContent>Deploying the documentation preview now.</BubbleContent>
        </Bubble>
        <MessageFooter>Delivered</MessageFooter>
      </MessageContent>
    </Message>

    <Message>
      <MessageAvatar>
        <Avatar><AvatarFallback>ST</AvatarFallback></Avatar>
      </MessageAvatar>
      <MessageContent>
        <MessageHeader>StackTrace</MessageHeader>
        <Bubble variant="muted">
          <BubbleContent>The new component examples are ready to inspect.</BubbleContent>
        </Bubble>
      </MessageContent>
    </Message>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { Avatar, AvatarFallback } from '@/Components/Avatar'
import { Bubble, BubbleContent } from '@/Components/Bubble'
import {
  Message,
  MessageAvatar,
  MessageContent,
  MessageFooter,
  MessageHeader,
} from '@/Components/Message'
</script>
```

## Alignment

Use `align="start"` for incoming messages and `align="end"` for the current sender. End alignment reverses the row, aligns nested Bubble surfaces, and keeps footer content on the same side. Keep a written sender name when alignment alone would be ambiguous.

## Header, footer, and avatar

`MessageHeader` suits sender names or short context above the surface. `MessageFooter` suits delivery state, timestamps, and message actions. The avatar anchors to the bottom of the message surface and shifts above a footer automatically.

## Grouping consecutive messages

Use `MessageGroup` for consecutive messages from one sender. An empty avatar slot on earlier rows preserves alignment; render the visible avatar on the final row. Use `BubbleGroup` inside one Message when several adjacent surfaces belong to the same logical message.

**Message group example**

```vue
<template>
  <MessageGroup class="w-full max-w-sm">
    <Message>
      <MessageAvatar aria-hidden="true" />
      <MessageContent>
        <Bubble variant="muted">
          <BubbleContent>I checked the component source.</BubbleContent>
        </Bubble>
      </MessageContent>
    </Message>
    <Message>
      <MessageAvatar>
        <Avatar><AvatarFallback>ST</AvatarFallback></Avatar>
      </MessageAvatar>
      <MessageContent>
        <BubbleGroup>
          <Bubble variant="muted">
            <BubbleContent>The styling now matches upstream.</BubbleContent>
          </Bubble>
          <Bubble variant="muted">
            <BubbleContent>The local API extensions are still intact.</BubbleContent>
          </Bubble>
        </BubbleGroup>
      </MessageContent>
    </Message>
  </MessageGroup>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { Avatar, AvatarFallback } from '@/Components/Avatar'
import { Bubble, BubbleContent, BubbleGroup } from '@/Components/Bubble'
import {
  Message,
  MessageAvatar,
  MessageContent,
  MessageGroup,
} from '@/Components/Message'
</script>
```

## Actions and semantics

Place copy, retry, feedback, or overflow actions in the footer and give icon-only controls an accessible label. Message is a presentational wrapper; put transcript semantics on the containing list. The [Message Scroller](https://ui.stacktrace.sk/docs/components/message-scroller) supplies a log region when you need streaming and transcript-aware scrolling.

## Content ownership

Message does not own chat records, delivery state, streaming, or actions. Keep those in the conversation feature and compose the parts needed for each row. Stable message identifiers belong on the list or MessageScroller item rather than inside the visual Bubble.

Hosted documentation: [Message](https://ui.stacktrace.sk/docs/components/message)
